[SWS_CM_10315] Discarding orphaned responses
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00212, RS_CM_00213
⌈
In case the method call has been canceled according to [SWS_CM_00194] in the
mean time, the received response/error messages of the canceled methods shall be
ignored.
